ns2:section.sectionText: *Eligible for PR minor. https://media.illinois.edu/pr_minor Students who have completed ADV 490 Sports PR should not register for ADV 290 Sports PR. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
